purpose: Auditable target geometry for expanding NGOFS2 transport extraction beyond Point Clear. Coordinates are public landmark proxies unless explicitly marked otherwise; MODEL guidance only.

targets.coordinate_basis: use existing owner/runtime private site coordinate if already configured locally; do not publish private home coordinate merely to support research branch
targets.implementation_rule: If no existing canonical private coordinate is available to the runtime, use adjacent public May Day/Fairhope model guidance only as PROXY and do not label it Montrose-local.

guardrails: Coordinates select MODEL extraction points; they are not Jubilee event locations.
Do not expose a private owner-home coordinate if the canonical runtime can resolve it without repository publication.
Run shoreline-normal sensitivity at plus/minus 15 degrees before assigning production weight.
Nearest named NGOFS2 station may be too far from a target; if so use regular-grid/unstructured model extraction rather than silently accepting a remote station.
No transport predictor receives positive production weight without held-out incremental value.
